description: This PHP source file defines the CustomerGroup controller class for the admin task module in an OpenCart project. It manages customer group data, including listing, info retrieval, JSON file generation, and cleanup.

classes.name: CustomerGroup
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer groups in the admin task module, including listing, info, JSON generation, and cleanup functions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates customer group task list by adding clear and list tasks.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Creates a JSON file with customer group list and associated tasks.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Generates a JSON file with detailed customer group information, including custom fields.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes generated JSON customer group files.
